newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau Jan-Aug trade deficit down 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Macau Jan-Aug trade deficit down 24 pct.

text.p: Macau's trade deficit shrank 24.4 percent year-on-year to 378 million patacas (US$47.2 million) in the first eight months of 1996, the Statistics and Census Department said on Wedensday.
Exports (fob) amounted to 10.1 billion patacas in the period, down 2.7 percent year-on-year.
Imports (cif) fell 3.7 percent to 10.4 billion patacas.
Macau, a Portuguese-administered enclave due to revert to China in 1999, is currently going through a recession in manufacturing, retail and property sectors.
